extracted.name: Carrot and Apple Cake
extracted.description: Cake is very healthy for child and it usually served in teaparty, you can serve it with one scoop vanilla icecream, its smell so good specially with Lemon peel grated🌸🌸
ingredient_lines: for lining the pan Parchment paper
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 180°C. Line a cake pan with parchment paper.
Grate 1 medium carrot. Mix with melted butter and cinnamon, set aside.
In a large bowl, beat 3 eggs for 5 minutes.
Add milk, oil or melted butter, and vanilla. Mix well.
Add baking powder and sifted flour. Stir until just combined.
Fold in the carrot mixture (and grated apple if using).
Pour batter into the prepared pan.
Arrange sliced apple on top and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 180°C until a skewer comes out clean. Enjoy!
